privacy.title: Hatimbotore kana kuchengeta nhamba yako yefoni
privacy.content: Kuchengetedza kuvanzika kwako, kambani yedu haichengeti zita rako, kero kana nhamba yefoni, uye hatitori nhamba dzefoni. Vatengi nevabatsiri vanobatana zvakachengeteka kuburikidza newebhusaiti ino kana app yeLIFE.HELP. Nhoroondo yekushandisa sevhisi yako inochengetwa pachigadzirwa chako chega, uye kana ukachinja chigadzirwa, nhoroondo yekare inogona kusatamiswa kuenda kuchitsva.
privacy.cardZeroPhoneDesc: Nhamba yako chaiyo yefoni haitorwi kana kuchengetwa, saka hapana njodzi yespam kana kuburitswa.
privacy.cardRealtimeChatDesc: Tumira mameseji nemutauro wako, anoturikirwa pachezvawo muchiKorea kuvabatsiri.
